name: tide_glass
theme: a morning shingle beach dives into one frosted green sea-glass pebble, through its pitted skin into the silica strands, folds into a foam realm of packed luminous bubble cells, and comes home over the standing wave-lattice to the surf line

registers.name: shingle_beach
registers.palette: morning white-gold and wet stone grey
registers.scene: a wide shingle beach in low morning light seen from a low viewpoint at the water's edge, broad banks of wet grey pebbles, a long white surf line along the shore, a thin film of bright water over the near stones, pale gold light laid flat across the whole beach, one small green sea-glass pebble among the wet stones
registers.target: a frosted green sea-glass pebble, its body clouded and matte, edges worn round
registers.loop_target: the wide shingle beach in low morning light, seen from a low viewpoint at the water's edge, wet grey pebbles and a long white surf line

registers.name: sea_glass
registers.palette: sea-glass green and pale frost white
registers.scene: a frosted green sea-glass pebble among the wet shingle, its clouded matte-green body worn round, a fine white bloom of frosting across the whole skin, small chips and nicks along the dull edges, wet grey stones banked around it
registers.target: a cluster of small round pits, shallow hollows ringed with pale white

registers.name: frosted_surface
registers.scene: the frosted surface of sea glass, a cratered pale green land of round pits and shallow smooth valleys, white rims around every hollow, fine scratches crossing the flats between them, the land running on to a dull worn edge beyond, bright morning light hard across the whole field
registers.target: glowing green strands, pale luminous threads knotted at bright points of light

registers.name: silica_network
registers.palette: luminous pale green on deep green dark
registers.scene: the silica network inside the glass, pale green strands strung between bright glowing nodes in every direction, a deep green dark behind the lattice of threads

registers.name: spray_foam
registers.palette: white-cyan light on deep sea green
registers.scene: a realm of packed luminous bubble cells, curved walls of white light dividing every cell from its neighbours, bright junctions where three walls meet, deep sea-green dark behind the whole packing
registers.target: a broad bright cell, a clear round chamber ringed by a sharp white wall

registers.name: wave_lattice
registers.palette: sunlit gold and deep green water
registers.scene: sunlit water seen from straight above, two sets of straight wave-lines crossed into a standing lattice, bright gold crests and dark green troughs in a regular diamond grid, a white glint at every crossing
registers.target: a long pale strip of shore, wet sand and dark stone banded along it

registers.name: surf_line
registers.scene: a stretch of shingle shore seen from low above, banks of wet grey pebbles, a long white surf line down the length of the shore, shallow bright rills of water between the stone banks, morning gold light across the wet ground

music_theme: a bright tidal morning — glassy bells and a light rolling swell over shimmering water, one clear crystalline bloom of sound landing on the glass-strand-to-foam seam
